landing.traditionHelp: It sets the prayers you can offer and the requests that reach your feed. You can change it later, in your profile.
landing.checkInboxText: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to activate your account — it can take up to a minute, and it sometimes lands in spam.
landing.howTitle: Three steps to your first prayer.
landing.howSub: Creo isn't a network for opinions. It's a place where you ask for prayer and someone, on the other side, actually prays.
landing.step1Text: Catholic or evangelical. It sets the prayers you can offer and the requests that reach you.
landing.step2Text: Write what's on your heart and decide who sees it: everyone, only your groups, or no one but you.
landing.step3Text: Each person records the prayer they offered. No comments, no debate — just the presence of those who stood with you.
landing.doTitle: Built for a community's life of prayer.
landing.doSub: Everything here serves one purpose: keeping people praying for one another.
landing.do1Text: Write an intention, choose who sees it, and mark it answered — with a testimony — when the prayer is answered.
landing.do2Text: Hail Mary, Our Father, Rosary. Or I prayed, Intercession, Fasting, Crying out. Each tradition has its own repertoire.
landing.do3Text: Ministries, cells and movements with their own wall, approval-based entry and admin roles.
landing.do4Text: Find people by @username and follow the intentions of those closest to you.
landing.do5Text: Admins post announcements with an image and a date — gatherings, novenas, service days — on the group wall.
landing.do6Text: Know when someone prayed for your intention, accepted your friend request or posted an announcement in your group.
landing.tradsTitle: The prayers are the ones from your faith.
landing.tradsSub: Instead of likes, each person records the prayer they offered. The tradition you choose defines that repertoire — and you can switch whenever you like, in your profile.
landing.tradCatholicText: The familiar devotions, the way your community prays them.
landing.tradEvangelicalText: The language of intercession, fasting and crying out.
landing.privacyTitle: You decide who sees each intention.
landing.privacySub: The choice is per request, not per account. And you can post anonymously when an intention is too delicate to carry your name.
landing.langsSub: Portuguese, English and Spanish. The preference follows you across devices, and you can switch at any time.
